title: WaitlistOfferExpiredV1
description: Outbox event (spec 11 §5.1) emitted when an outstanding waitlist offer lapses past its deadline before the customer responds. Informs the customer the held spot was released. The freed opening is re-matched via a separate waitlist.commands.match.v1 message. Carries only opaque ids and the notification channel (Inv-12).

message_type.description: Explicit schema discriminator; always 'waitlist.offer.expired.v1' for this contract.

correlation_id.description: Correlation identifier propagated across the waitlist chain (the enrollment id).

offer_id.description: Stable id of the expired waitlist_offers row.

enrollment_id.description: Stable id of the originating waitlist_enrollments row.

customer_ref.description: Opaque tenant-scoped customer reference; never raw contact details (Inv-12).

notification_channel.description: Customer's chosen delivery channel for the expiry notification.

slot_start_at.description: Start time of the slot whose offer expired.
